content: Hahan jointi rishtajatibo
Jerusalen janinhax sca caibo nocoti becani. Fariseobo betan jaton huisha honanbo. Nocoxon sca:
—Miin haxenicabaan ta mechoquihxonma pihiqui. ¿Jahua copi jascajacaniquin, noquen xenibaan yohini quescajayamaquin? —hahcanquin yocaquin.
—Maton caya tah man Papa Diosen yohini quescajayamanoxon huetsajaquin jonibo haxemahi. ¿Jahua copi man jascajahin?

Papan ta yohinishqui: Miin papahon queenhue; miin mamahon rihbi queenhue hahquin. Huetsa rihbi jan yohini: Jahuen papa qui tiromahi yohuanai joni queyocahinnon tah man rehtetihi. Jahuen mama qui tiromahi yohuanai joni jascajaribiquin.

Papan mato jascajaquin yohinih bi tah man huetsajaquin jonibo yohihi. Jaton mamaboya jaton papabo yanapanyamahabo hihxon tah man jato yohihi, Maton papabo man yanapanpanan Papa Dios hinantijanahue hah tah man jato jai.
Jascajaquin tah man maton haxemati joiyaxon Papan joi nincayamamahi, jonibaan nincapanan.
¡Nincacoinihcamahibon! Mato yohihi ta sirijaquin Isaíasnen yohinishqui:

content.text: Jaton janan nea jonibo hehqui siripi yohuanih bi ta jaton jointinin jahuabi nincayamahiqui.
Nescajaquin Papa Dios hahxonnahue hihxon bi ta jonibaan shinanax yohuanai joi res haxemacaniqui. Jaa copi ta yanca bi res hea yocacaniqui

content: —jato jaquin.
Tsamataibo sca Benahue hahxon: —Nincaxon nincaquin sirijanahue.
Piquin non noquen poco janin nanehiton ta noquen jointi rishtajayamahiqui. Noque jointi rishtajahi ta noquen jana janinhax picotaibo qui —jato jaquin.
Jahuen haxenicabo sca jaa pataxi becani. Pataxxon sca: —¿Min yohihi nincacax fariseobo sinascai min honanyamahin? —hihcani.
—Jahuen huai janin jaan banayamani meraxon ta heen Papan mexabahinxon potatihiqui.
Sinaresnon jato jenenahue. Benchexon bi ta bahi jismahi bebobonacaniqui. Benchen hahbe benche hiohax ta rabebi xanqueman paquetihiqui.
—Min noque yohiha jaa patax queha joi, jahua hihcatsihquiquin? Noque yohihue —hahquin Pedronen.
—¿Maton rihbi man honanyamaparihin?
¿Noquen jana janin hihquihax noquen poco janin huinotax pohi sca jatihibi piti picotihqui man honanyamahin?
Noquen jana janinhax cainaibo ta noquen jointi janinhax cainihqui. Jascapahbaan ta noquen jointi rishtajahiqui.
Noquen jointi janinhax cainai ta shinan tiromabo qui. Joni rehteti, tsiniti, haiboya shiroti, yometsohti, joni huetsa qui quesahi yohuanti, Papa qui tiromahi yohuanti.
Jascapahbo shinan ta hahan jointi rishtatih qui. Mechoquihxonma piquin bi tah non jascajaquin noquen jointi rishtajatimahi —jato jaquin.
Jesus nincacoinai jaton nahua haibo
Janohax picotax sca Tiro jema janinbo sca Jesus betan bocani, Sidon jema janinbo cahi, Jesus betan.

Jesus nocotai merahax Cananeo haibo sca jahui, jano jihuetai haibo. Quenáhonahi joxon hihti yocaquin. —Hehon shinanhue, Hihbon, Davidinin baquen. Yoshiman hihbojaha ta heen baque haibo hihti hisinihqui —hahquin.
Hihti yocacah bi jahua hihyamahi. Jahuen haxenicabaan sca Jesus pataxxon yohiquin: —Yohihue, jan catannon. Sai saihihanan ta noque chibanbenahiqui —hahcanquin.
—Noquen nahuabo qui ma bi manotai Israeli baquebo qui res hen jonon ta Papan hea raannishqui —Jesusen jaquin.
Jaa bebon sca joxon betihihpaquexon haibaan yohiquin: —Jenquetsaha ra hea jaxonhue, Hihbon.
—Baquebo bichinxon hochiti jaton piti hinanah ta tiroma qui —Jesusen jaquin.
—Tiroma rahan, Hihbon. Jaabi ta jaton hihbaan misa janinhax paquetai teque romishin hochitinin piti qui —hahquin haibaan.
—Min tah min shinancoinai, haibon. Min yocacai quescabijaquin tah hen mia hahxonai —Jesusen jaquin. Jaatianbi ta jaa haibaan baque siricahinnishqui, rohascai.
Mesco hisinyahpabo Jesusen rohajahi
Janohax cahax sca, Galilea hian quetanbahini cahax, mahchi manichish jano Jesus tsahoti.

Hihti caibo jonibo jahui, jaa chibanbenahi. Jaton hisinyahpabo hihuecanquin, chantobo, benchebo, meyosmabo, joyobo, mesco hisinyahpabo hicha bi res becanquin. Jesus bebonbi jato taracanrenencanquin, jato jatihibi rohajascanon.

Jato rohajahiya ta tsinquijaquetaibo rahte rahtenishqui. Joyobo yohuanscai, meyosmabo siricahinscai, chantobo nihresscai, benchebaan jisresscaiya, rahtetax: —Noquen Papa Diosen ta hihtijaquin noque hahxonihqui —hihcani.
Cuatro mil bebobo Jesusen pimahi

Jahuen haxenicabo quenabohanxon sca Jesusen jato yohiquin. —Nea tsinquijaquetaibohon tah hen shinanai. Quimisha neten sca ta nenobi banecaniqui, pihan ta hihcanihqui. Pihaxma cati tah hen jato yohicatsihyamahi. Bahin cahi bi pihaxmahuan hihquish nocoyamacanmis. Jatohon tah hen shinanai —jato jaquin.
—¿Jahuerahnon non tsoabi jano jihueyamahi janin hicha piti marotihin? Jaabo ta hicha qui —hah sca jacanquin jahuen haxenicabaan.
—¿Jahuentihi paan man jain? —jato jaquin. —Siete res ta qui. Yapa pishca rihbi —hahcanquin.
Tsamajaquetaibo mihtsahohti yohiscaquin, Jesusen.
Yohixon jaton siete paanya yapa pishca bihxon Papa yohixon tehcapaquexon jahuen haxenicabo hinanquin, jaabaan sca jonibo hinanpaquerihbinon.
Pihax yanicahinaibaan bi texejaribicanquin. Texejahabo tequebo tsinquixon siete tasa bocho bihcanquin.
Haiboboya baquebo toponyamahah bi bebo rahsi toponah ta cuatro mil joni janishqui.
Jonibo camahah cahiya sca ta nontin nanetax Magdala jema janin taxnati bocannishqui.
